title: 800: Murali ka aakhri wicket, aakhri Test mein 🏏 #shorts
facebook_title: 800: Murali's last wicket in his last Test
caption:
Aakhri Test, aakhri din… aur 800 ke liye chahiye tha bas ek wicket! 🏏

Galle, July 2010: Muttiah Muralitharan ko apne aakhri Test mein 800 tak pahunchne ke liye 8 wicket chahiye the. India ki aakhri jodi 15 over se zyada tiki rahi. Phir Ojha ka kinara, slip mein Jayawardene ka catch… aur Test career ki aakhri gend par 800!

Kya koi yeh record tod payega? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
